study: Short the desk's own buy fills, with the live exits mirrored. If the desk buys at the end of the run, does selling short at that moment, and covering with the desk's own stop, trail, ratchet and trend hold turned upside down, make money after the spread?
registered_at: 2026-10-19, before any return in this study was computed.
origin: Operator 2026-10-19, after TURN_OPEN_2026-10-19 (FAIL): 'invert the longs for shorts. We can keep our opens the way they are since they open at the end of the profit run. We can capture the loss in its entirety.' Also: use the smaller momentum names, the floor lowered to $2. 'We would have to restructure the exits and ratchet logic to work with shorts.' This study tests that before any live code is restructured.
prior_evidence: Stated before the run. SHORT_SQUARES_2026-10-02 part B flipped 234 desk fills (09-23..10-02, primary set) to shorts with fixed holds: 30 m with a +3% buy-stop +0.07% (t 0.7) and +0.01% (t 0.2), medians negative, about +0.2-0.3% gross at 30 m. Its part A (shorting at the square signal, 1,604 trades) lost in every cell. The long side's gross is about zero (MOMENTUM_RUNWAY, TURN_OPEN), so a mirror pays the spread again. Expected result: a net per trade near zero or below. What is new here: the desk's own exit stack run on the short, about four more weeks of fills (half B is unseen), and the sub-$10 fills reported at their own cost.
population: Every filled desk BUY order (event fill, side buy, filled_avg_price > 0) in ai_reports/fills/DAY.jsonl and ~/session_snapshots/DAY/fills.jsonl, sessions 2026-09-23 through 2026-10-16, filled 09:30-15:45 ET, one row per order_id (earliest fill time). Nothing about the fill is changed: the desk's own names, sources, gates and timing pick every trade.
trade: Short at the first SIP round-lot print (>= 100 shares) strictly after the fill time, within 120 s (none: no fill, counted). The short is covered by the desk's live exit code (tools/replay_session.FakeBroker._live_exit via tools/call_exits.simulate, the live config on the mini) run on the MIRRORED price path p' = E^2 / p, where E is the entry print: a price rise against the short is a fall in the mirror, so the initial stop sits above entry, the local trail and ratchet leash follow the low, trail_dc's trend hold reads mirrored 1-minute bars (high' = E^2/low, low' = E^2/high, close' = E^2/close, completed bars only), dead trade and the 15:50 flatten as live. The cover fills at the first real print strictly after the exit decision. Return = (E - cover) / E. The run refuses if ai_exit_supertrend is on (its bars come from another store and would not be mirrored).
cost: The full SIP quoted spread at the entry (replay_costing.entry_spread_bp), charged once; no NBBO -> that day's pooled median, counted. Plus 0.5 bp of sell-side regulatory fees. Borrow 0 for easy-to-borrow names held intraday (Alpaca charges borrow on positions held overnight; every trade here is flat by 15:50). A line with 7 bp more on stop and trail exits (buy-stop slippage) is printed.

sets.primary: entry print >= $10, Alpaca asset shortable AND easy_to_borrow, and no short-sale restriction at entry. SSR: the day's lowest 1-minute low before the entry <= 90% of the previous close, or the previous session's low <= 90% of the close before it.
sets.information: $10+ with any flags; $5-10 and $2-5 tiers, each also with the tier round-trip cost of short_fade_study (0.40% / 1.00%) instead of the measured spread; hard-to-borrow, not shortable and SSR rows. None of these enter the word.

halves: A: sessions 2026-09-23..2026-10-02 (overlaps SHORT_SQUARES part B, so partly seen). B: 2026-10-05..2026-10-16 (unseen as a short).
controls: Printed, not in the word: (1) the same fills LONG through the same simulator, unmirrored (the desk's own exits from the first print after its fill), net of the same spread; (2) the short held a fixed 30 minutes (cover at the first print after entry + 30 min, or at the 15:50 flatten), the SHORT_SQUARES cell without its stop; (3) the scaled breakeven line of call_exits (offset 0.10% of the fill instead of $0.01).
call: On the primary set, per-day mean net per trade, day-clustered. PASS: mean > 0 in half A and in half B; pooled t >= 2; the 7 bp stop-slippage line pooled > 0; the pooled mean > 0 with the 3 best days removed. PROMISING: mean > 0 in both halves and pooled t >= 1.5. FAIL otherwise. UNDERPOWERED: fewer than 12 scored days or 200 primary trades. NOT READ: asset flags unknown for more than 25% of the $10+ rows.
what_is_printed: Fills loaded, deduplicated, no entry print, by price tier; flags (easy-to-borrow, hard-to-borrow, not shortable, unknown), SSR count. Per set and half: trades, days, net per trade (t), median, wins, the 7 bp line, the scaled line, the 30-minute line, the long control, the squeeze (highest real price before the cover vs entry: p50, p95, p99, max), MDE at t 2. Exit reasons. The 3 best days.
known_limits: Asset flags are today's (Alpaca, via the data-only account's keys, or the 2026-10-02 shortable.json cache), not the day of the trade; a name easy to borrow today may not have been. Locates, short rejections and broker buy-stop behaviour are not modelled. Dollar-denominated settings (the breakeven cent, ai_profit_capture_px) act on the mirrored price, which differs from the real one by the size of the move. The exhaustion (%R) exit is not run, as in call_exits. Today's live config replays every day, not each day's own config.
no_retuning: The population, the mirror, the 120 s entry, the costs, the sets, the halves and the bars are fixed. A different exit, hold, filter or universe (for example sub-$10 names the desk never bought) is a new prereg. A PASS earns a forward paper period on the short side, never money directly.
command: On the mini after 16:15 ET, from the repo root: TH_DATA_SECRETS=$PWD/secrets_data.json nice -n 19 .venv/bin/python tools/studies/fill_short.py. Data-only account; no order is placed; no config edit.
amendment_2026-10-19: Result-skeptic Mode 1 NOT READY, before any run; fixed before any return was computed: (1) the short keeps the desk's T1 scale-out blend (half covered at the mirrored target_1, real price E^2/target_1), and call_exits.finalize_at_session_end keeps it on both sides; (2) call_exits.simulate now also patches ai_positions._symbol_bars_for_double_check to completed (mirrored) bars, so double_check_sell and no_progress's double check cannot read the whole day; (3) fetch errors are printed by day and the word is NOT READ above 5% of attempted fills; (4) asset flags come from one get_all_assets call on the data-only keys, missing names are retried each run, and the 2026-10-02 cache supplies only its True flags (it wrote errors as [False, False]); (5) a failed daily-bar request or a name with no prior daily bar reads SSR unknown and is kept out of primary; (6) today's low for SSR includes the prints from the fill to the entry and the entry print; (7) UNDERPOWERED also when either half has fewer than 5 scored days; (8) the missing fixed-30 count is printed; (9) tests: the trend hold receives mirrored, completed bars and its hold keeps the short; the T1 blend; point-in-time double-check bars; the new refusals; (10) the result states it is SIP-only (the live desk trades on IEX). ai_exit_range cannot apply (replay positions carry no range_r_btm).
